const j = $input.first().json;
return j.replies.map(text => ({ json: { to: j.phone, from: j.from, text } }));

parameters.content:
## Texting with the customer
Every reply the customer sends lands here. STOP and START are handled by rules. Otherwise Claude reads the whole thread, the price list and the open slots, and answers with a short text plus what it learned about the job.

Emergencies and call-back requests text the owner straight away. In demo mode nothing is sent.
